datasets.name: Condition monitoring of hydraulic systems

validation.split_unit: complete 60-second load cycle and any repeated operating-condition group
validation.required_guard: never split samples within a cycle; hold out condition combinations or acquisition blocks when testing generalization
validation.leakage_risk: random window or row splits copy nearly identical operating cycles across folds

adapter.profile: dor uci-hydraulic-prepare; historical derived views remain under examples/hydraulic_*

prohibited_claims: discrete condition classes are not continuous physical parameter identification
a derived feature subset is not a raw-signal benchmark
component-wise simultaneous faults must be evaluated as multi-label localization rather than collapsed to one class

datasets.name: Case Western Reserve University Bearing Data Center

access.redistribution: link to official source; verify terms before redistribution

validation.split_unit: entire MAT recording and fault specimen
validation.required_guard: specimen- or condition-held-out evaluation; do not random-split overlapping windows from one recording
validation.leakage_risk: window identity and fixed rig conditions can dominate fault evidence

prohibited_claims: seeded faults do not establish natural-damage field performance
fault diameter classes do not prove continuous severity estimation

datasets.name: Paderborn University Bearing Data Center

validation.required_guard: hold out whole bearings; report artificial-to-real and cross-operating-condition transfer separately
validation.leakage_risk: measurements repeat per bearing and operating condition

prohibited_claims: random measurement splits do not prove unseen-bearing generalization
non-commercial license limits deployment and redistribution

datasets.name: IMS Bearings

access.license: NASA public-data terms; dataset page does not state a separate license

datasets.fault_origin: accelerated natural degradation under test conditions

validation.split_unit: entire run-to-failure experiment and bearing channel
validation.required_guard: time-ordered evaluation with training before evaluation; no future windows in training
validation.leakage_risk: random temporal splits expose future degradation state and adjacent-window autocorrelation

prohibited_claims: terminal failure notes are not dense fault-onset truth
few runs cannot identify a universally optimal architecture

datasets.name: FEMTO-ST PRONOSTIA Bearing Data Set

access.license: not stated by PHM Society mirror
access.redistribution: link to official mirror; verify terms before redistribution

validation.required_guard: hold out whole bearings and preserve temporal order
validation.leakage_risk: random windows leak bearing identity and future health trajectory

prohibited_claims: RUL evidence is not fault-type classification evidence

datasets.name: NASA Advanced Diagnostics and Prognostics Testbed

access.license: NASA public-data terms; dataset page does not state a separate license

validation.split_unit: complete experimental run and injected-fault scenario
validation.required_guard: hold out entire runs/scenarios and bind topology edges plus truth to source provenance
validation.leakage_risk: scenario templates, commanded configuration and adjacent telemetry reveal run identity

prohibited_claims: the bundled synthetic fixture is not the real ADAPT benchmark
topology proximity alone is not root-cause evidence

datasets.name: MetroPT-3 Dataset
modality: multivariate timestamped sensor and digital signal stream
datasets.fault_origin: real operational failures documented by maintenance reports
labels: timestamped failure intervals and component reports

validation.required_guard: forward-chaining temporal split with an exclusion gap around maintenance/failure boundaries
validation.leakage_risk: random rows leak neighboring timestamps and post-maintenance state

prohibited_claims: maintenance intervals are not precise component-onset timestamps
one train compressor does not prove fleet transfer

datasets.name: DCASE 2025 Task 2 machine-condition audio datasets
datasets.device_domain: fans, gearboxes, bearings, rails, valves and toy machines

access.license: dataset-specific Creative Commons terms on Zenodo records

datasets.fault_origin: challenge-defined anomalous operating sounds across unseen machine types

validation.split_unit: complete recording, machine section and domain
validation.leakage_risk: mixing machine IDs or source/target domains removes the intended generalization test

adapter.profile: raw WAV audio encoder and DCASE partition adapter

prohibited_claims: DOR numeric time-series summaries do not consume raw audio
task anomaly detection does not establish component localization

datasets.name: Industrial Robot Telemetry Dataset for Predictive Maintenance
datasets.fault_origin: intentionally altered robot operation; not documented natural failure

validation.required_guard: hold out full executions and operating programs
validation.leakage_risk: random telemetry rows leak execution identity and adjacent dynamics

prohibited_claims: altered operation is not necessarily physical damage
one robot does not establish cross-embodiment transfer

datasets.name: Industrial Screw Driving Dataset
datasets.fault_origin: natural wear plus controlled process variations

validation.split_unit: complete fastening operation and acquisition campaign
validation.required_guard: hold out chronological wear blocks or campaign groups
validation.leakage_risk: random operations can leak gradual tool wear and repeated settings

prohibited_claims: scenario recognition is not automatically causal fault diagnosis
random-operation accuracy does not prove future-wear performance

datasets.name: PMSM inverter fault dataset
datasets.fault_origin: controlled inverter and thermal fault conditions

validation.split_unit: complete acquisition run and operating condition
validation.required_guard: hold out runs or condition combinations, never adjacent rows
validation.leakage_risk: 10 Hz adjacent rows and derived columns can duplicate condition identity

prohibited_claims: derived variables are not independent sensor evidence
discrete fault conditions do not support continuous parameter identification

datasets.name: Induction motor startup-current fault dataset
datasets.fault_origin: healthy, one/two broken rotor bars and damaged ring specimens

validation.required_guard: hold out complete starts and report leave-one-motor-out separately
validation.leakage_risk: window splits identify the same startup or specimen

prohibited_claims: four motors do not prove fleet-wide transfer
fault-class count is not a calibrated continuous damage estimate

datasets.name: XJTU-DV Dynamic Vision Dataset

datasets.fault_origin: controlled mechanical vibration and fault experiments

validation.split_unit: complete experiment recording and physical setup
validation.required_guard: hold out recordings/setups before extracting frames

prohibited_claims: DOR numeric time-series IR cannot consume raw dynamic vision

datasets.name: PATH Powertrain Anomaly Time-series Benchmark
